scope: Connection from the published HTTPS page https://airpocket-soundman.github.io/airpocket-simulation-studio/ in the owner's regular Chrome to a local connector (scripts/studio-mcp.mjs --browser-origin=https://airpocket-soundman.github.io, 127.0.0.1) with inspect scope only. The pairing code was typed by the owner; the assistant only issued inspect-scope calls and read connector diagnostics.

environment.pageBuild: older cached build: inspect reported 86 browser methods while main had 87-88, so the page did not yet include meshBoundaryPreflight/checkGpuEnvironment; the exact served revision is not recorded

earlierAttempt.detail: First attempt: the page showed that the local connector could not be reached; connector counters showed 1 request (a local /health issued by the assistant) and 0 preflights, 0 pairing attempts, 0 refusals, so the browser's requests never reached the connector. The cause was not identified from the page side; the owner then got it to work and the setting that changed was not reported. Documented candidates: Chrome local-network-access permission, the coi service worker.
